About Zenith Dental

We are Redefining the Dental Experience

At Zenith Dental, we believe a visit to the dentist should be as relaxing as a trip to a day spa. Founded in 2010 by Dr. Sarah Mitchell, our clinic focuses on minimally invasive, preventive treatments customized for every patient.

Our modern facility features state-of-the-art digital 3D imaging, silent dental drills, and high-definition entertainment screens mounted on the ceilings to ensure your complete comfort during appointments.

From routine checkups to cosmetic restoration, we provide modern treatments for patients of all ages.
